messages:
Alex Nguyen: Quick check — CobaltEdge private rollout hitting two blockers in staging: 1) image pull failing in air-gapped cluster (x509) 2) customer asking for an egress fallback plan if NAT bucket/CR fails. Anyone owning certs/registry import and the egress fallback?

Sasha Rivera: I can take the registry cert path. can you paste the exact error?

Alex Nguyen: here —
```
failed to pull image: Get "https://registry.internal.company/api/v2/": x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
```

Jamal Ortiz: that's the registry CA not present on the node CA store. we usually ship it via the airgap bootstrap tarball (images+certs). did the customer run the updated bootstrap (v1.3.2)?

Alex Nguyen: they pulled v1.3.1. I sent v1.3.2 to SE yesterday but not sure it landed.

Priya Kaur: tagging compliance: if we push a fallback that uses public egress, we need a signed CR and the customer's approval — they explicitly requested no outbound to internet unless failover engaged.

Deploy Bot: [deploy-staging] image-pull-failure detected for cobaltedge/staging - job id 8721 - see CI log: https://ci.redwood.internal/8721

Sandeep Iyer: Alex, I have a small PR that updates the bootstrap to include the CA bundle and a retry on the image mirror pull (PR #3456). I can fast-track review if you need it today.

Alex Nguyen: pinging PR owner @Sandeep Iyer — can you review? customer target is Tue next week.

Sandeep Iyer: yep i'll review now. if green I'll merge + tag a hotfix release.

Infra Eng: for the egress fallback, we usually configure a bastion NAT route + firewall rules scoped to customer IPs. Jamal — we still need the CIDR list from the customer's network team to add to the allowlist, right?

Jamal Ortiz: correct. i sent the template for CIDRs to the SE on Friday. no reply yet. if they can't provide ranges we can propose the documented fallback: outbound via managed-bastion (TLS-only) through our audited gateway, but that's a higher-risk policy and requires Ops + Legal signoff.

Sasha Rivera: action item: I'll repackage v1.3.2 bootstrap with the CA bundle and upload to the airgap S3 tonight. Alex — can you confirm the customer applies that and re-runs the bootstrap?

Alex Nguyen: will coordinate with SE (Marisol) now. also: SE asked whether we can do a one-off manual import into their cluster to unblock verification — acceptable?

Priya Kaur: manual import ok for pre-prod staging only. For production, we need the formal bootstrap. document the manual steps and get a short email ACK from the customer.

Sandeep Iyer: merged PR #3456, created tag v1.3.2-hotfix. changelog: added CA bundle, improved mirror retry loop.

Deploy Bot: [artifact-upload] v1.3.2-hotfix uploaded to artifacts.redwood/internal (sha256: ab12...ef34)

Alex Nguyen: thanks. Marisol (SE) confirmed she'll run bootstrap tonight and test image pull tomorrow morning. I'll update here when they report.

Jamal Ortiz: on the egress fallback policy — can we get an explicit milestone? if customer can't provide CIDRs by EOD tomorrow we escalate to the fallback approval path.

Alex Nguyen: milestone: CIDR list by EOD tomorrow (Mon). fallback approval request if missing. owner: Jamal (netops) + Priya (compliance).

Priya Kaur: noted. I'll draft a minimal approval packet (risk summary + controls) and share in this thread by 10:30 PT tomorrow.

Sasha Rivera: uploaded new bootstrap: s3://airgap-builds/cobaltedge/v1.3.2-hotfix/bootstrap.tar.gz

Alex Nguyen: confirmed SE started bootstrap at 21:16 PT. will ping after image pull validation.

Sandeep Iyer: small follow-up — I also added a retry metric to the console so we can see how often mirror fallbacks are used. keep an eye on the model-serving route.

Infra Eng: scheduling a quick 20-min sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to finalize fallback wording for the CR. Jamal + Priya + Alex + SE invited.

Jamal Ortiz: noted. if CIDRs don't arrive, recommend we prepare a scoped access SR to customer SOC for temporary NAT allocation.

Alex Nguyen: thanks everyone — will update thread after SE confirmation. :thumbsup:

Marisol (SE): bootstrap completed, image pull OK now. staging health checks all green. will start small smoke test for model-serving in 30 mins.

Alex Nguyen: great news — marking staging unblock. leaving fallback milestone open until CIDRs confirmed.

Priya Kaur: received — I'll still prepare the approval packet in case we need it for prod.

Sandeep Iyer: closing loop on PR monitoring. will post if we see mirror retries > 5% during the smoke.

Alex Nguyen: closing this thread after final prod prep. thanks all. :party_popper:
